text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Error spike on generation API (5xx rate > 3% over 5m). Pager notified to #eng-oncall and #support.

Sam: Acknowledged. I'm on it — grabbing logs and will triage. tagging @CS-bot for customer ack templates.

Maria: Thanks — I'll prep a short customer-facing ack that support can send immediately. Keep me posted on rollback/fallback options.

Kevin: Quick triage notes: can we confirm if it's model-compute or routing? Steps I'm running: 1) check model pool health 2) check recent deploys 3) review autoscale errors. If model pool healthy, probably routing/fallback config.

Sam: First quick findings: one host in pool 3 returned OOMs ~2m ago and evicted. Autoscaler tried to spin a replacement but hit image pull delay. Reducing load to fallback model now.

Maria: Draft customer acknowledgement (short):

```
Hi — we're aware of increased errors on the text generation API and are actively investigating. Our engineering team is working on mitigation; some requests may experience errors or fallbacks to lower-capacity model variants. We'll update within 30 minutes with progress and next steps. Sorry for the disruption. — Redwood Support
```

Sam: Sending that as Zendesk macro now (macro name: "INC - immediate ack - gen-api"). Use tags: incident, gen-api, customer-impact.

CS-bot: Zendesk macro snippet ready:

```
Subject: We're investigating errors on the generation API
Body: Hi {{ticket.requester.name}},
We're currently investigating elevated errors on the generation endpoints which may affect requests. Our engineers have applied temporary fallbacks and are working to restore normal service. We'll follow up within 30 minutes.
Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Support
```

Maria: Add the line "If you notice degraded quality please reply and include an example request/response" to capture repro.

Kevin: Live checklist for on-call (copy to thread):
1) Verify model-host health: `kubectl -n runtime get pods -o wide` and look for restarts/oomkilled.
2) Check autoscaler events: `kubectl describe hpa` or autoscale logs.
3) Inspect router logs for 503/504 patterns and matching timestamps.
4) If a host is OOMing, remove it from pool and rely on fallback model variant.
5) If image pull is blocking, temporarily toggle to pre-pulled image tag and scale up.
6) Notify CS with ETA and mitigation steps.
7) Update status page if customer-impact confirmed > 5% error rate or sustained > 10m.

Sam: I removed the bad node from rotation and forced fallback for traffic > 20 tokens. Error rate dropped from 3.7% to ~1.1% after fallback. Continuing to monitor.

Maria: Good. Can someone draft a status page blurb? Short, factual, and include affected regions/ETA.

Kevin: Status page suggestion:
```
Summary: Customers may see elevated error rates (5xx) for the generation API.
Impact: Partial request failures or fallbacks to lower-capacity models impacting latency and output quality for a subset of requests.
Cause: Under investigation — host OOM and image pull delays causing capacity reduction.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to fallback models and impacted host removed from pool. Engineers actively rebuilding capacity.
ETA: Monitoring; expected stabilization within 30–45 minutes.
```

Sam: I'm going to escalate to infra if image pull not resolved in 10 minutes. Also posting a short internal handoff summary for the next oncall: current mitigation, what to revert, and where to find logs.

Maria: Customer reply templates (Zendesk macros / Intercom quick replies):
- Short ack (for quick replies): "We're investigating and have applied temporary fallbacks. We'll update within 30 minutes."
- Technical outreach (for large customers): "We're experiencing elevated 5xx errors on the generation endpoint. We've routed traffic to fallback model variants and removed an impacted host from rotation. Our infra team is rebuilding capacity. We'll follow up with timeline and next steps."

CS-bot: Example Intercom quick reply (copyable):

```
We're aware of an issue affecting generation responses. We have temporary fallbacks in place to reduce impact; our engineers are restoring capacity. If you'd like, please share a recent request ID and we'll investigate.
```

Kevin: Note for post-incident: capture sample request IDs, the failing host ID, autoscaler events, and the exact image pull error. We'll run an RCA on the failure mode (OOM -> image pull -> insufficient pre-pulled images).

Sam: Last update: error rate stable at ~0.9%, fallback in place, ramping a replacement host. I'll update status page with Kevin's blurb and close this thread after the next 30m check.

Maria: Thanks all — CS will hold macros ready and send manual updates for affected customers who open tickets. If anything changes call the bridge. :thumbsup:
